name: Loyalty for Love
source:
You are an independent young woman who runs a homely, old-fashioned bakery together with your grandmother. Your peaceful life is shattered when a few suspicious customers show up at the bakery: three handsome men dressed in black.

They forcibly take you away in a limousine to the office building of the highly esteemed “S Group,” a company so rich they own practically every inch of the city. The CEO of S Group reveals to you a complex family history: you are his illegitimate granddaughter and he has decided to make you the next heir of the company.

If you agree, the economic security and safety of your grandmother are secured. You are reluctant at first, but you can’t turn down the promise of a better life for your grandmother.
However, being an heiress isn’t all fun and games; you must undergo special training to be shaped into a proper lady… with the three handsome men as your guides?!

Given the order to change yourself into someone you’re not… are you up to the task?
How will you adjust to a new lifestyle with your new butlers?
translation:
你是一名独立自主的年轻女性，与祖母一起经营着一家温馨的老式面包店。一天，几位可疑的顾客出现在店里，打破了你平静的生活——三个身穿黑衣的英俊男人。

他们强行将你带上一辆豪华轿车，送往声名显赫的“S集团”办公大楼。这家公司富可敌国，几乎拥有整座城市的每一寸土地。S集团的首席执行官向你揭开了一段复杂的家族往事：你是他非婚生的孙女，而他已经决定让你成为公司的下一任继承人。

只要答应，祖母的生活与安全就都有了保障。虽然一开始心有抗拒，但你无法拒绝让祖母过上更好生活的机会。
然而，当继承人可不只是享乐；为了成为合格的淑女，你必须接受特别训练……而指导你的人，就是那三个英俊男人？！

被要求变成另一个自己……你能胜任吗？
与新管家们一起的新生活，又该如何适应？
